privileged_info_for_vlm: The view must be named 'FormattedTrackList'. Required columns and sources: 'Artist' (Artist.Name), 'Album' (Album.Title), 'Track' (Track.Name), and 'Duration'. The 'Duration' must be calculated from 'Milliseconds' using the logic: minutes = Milliseconds / 60000, seconds = (Milliseconds % 60000) / 1000. The final format must be a string 'MM:SS' (e.g., 4:05). Ensure the agent uses the Chinook database schema.
